title: GEM-MM: Reducing VLM Hallucination with Entropy-Guided Preference Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.20016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are routinely aligned with offline pairwise RLHF objectives, but multimodal preference data is scarce and treats every response token as equally informative. Under a small preference budget, pair construction becomes nearly irrelevant: standard DPO-style, image-conditional, and self-improvement objectives all perform within 1.1 points on MM-RLHF metrics and 0.5 points on hallucination rates, matching the SFT baseline. We call this entropy-blind preference optimization: the learning signal ignores policy uncertainty, which in chain-of-thought VLMs concentrates on specific fork tokens where visual claims are made. We introduce GEM-MM, extending entropy-guided preference modeling to VLMs. It samples on-policy candidates, rewards high-entropy reasoning forks, penalizes uncertain final answers, and updates the model via group-normalized policy gradients. On a 3000-prompt MM-RLHF budget with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct,

translated_title: GEM-MM：通过熵引导的偏好对齐减少视觉语言模型的幻觉
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）通常通过与离线成对RLHF目标进行对齐来训练，但多模态偏好数据稀缺，且传统方法将每个响应标记视为同等重要。在较小的偏好数据预算下，偏好样本对的构建几乎变得无关紧要：标准的DPO风格、图像条件化以及自我改进的目标在MM-RLHF指标上的表现差异不超过1.1分，幻觉率差异不超过0.5分，均与SFT基线相当。我们将这种现象称为“熵盲偏好优化”：学习信号忽略了策略的不确定性，而在思维链式VLM中，这种不确定性恰恰集中在进行视觉断言的特定分叉标记上。我们提出了GEM-MM，将熵引导的偏好建模扩展到视觉语言模型。该方法通过在线策略采样候选响应，奖励高熵的推理分叉，惩罚不确定的最终答案，并通过组归一化策略梯度更新模型。在使用Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct模型、3000条提示的MM-RLHF预算下……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出GEM-MM方法，通过熵引导的偏好对齐（采样在线策略候选、奖励高熵推理分叉、惩罚不确定答案并采用组归一化策略梯度更新）来减少视觉语言模型的幻觉，克服了传统“熵盲”偏好优化在小偏好数据预算下失效的问题。
